TRIXX Technologies division

TRIXX AgriTech

Exploring digital tools that help farmers organize farm activities, monitor costs and make better-informed operational decisions.

The opportunity

Problems worth solving.

Farm activities, inputs and costs can be hard to track consistently, particularly where connectivity is limited. This division explores field-friendly digital records.

Who we aim to serve

Farmers and agricultural operators who want practical ways to organize field activity and farm records.

Areas of focus

What this division is exploring.

  • 01Farm and crop records
  • 02Planting and harvesting calendars
  • 03Farm input inventory
  • 04Cost and revenue tracking
  • 05Irrigation planning
  • 06Pest and disease reporting
  • 07Weather information integrations
  • 08Harvest and sales records
  • 09Offline-friendly field data capture

No guaranteed yield, profit or scientifically validated farming advice is claimed. Weather integrations and other capabilities depend on future development and third-party services. These items describe focus or development areas, not a claim that products or services are already operational.
